en.title: Ellen Burstyn, 93, Calls Working Today a 'Miracle' After Career Fears
en.summary: Legendary actress Ellen Burstyn reflects on a career that defied her own expectations. At 93, she continues to work and receive prestigious honors, a reality she once thought impossible.
en.body:
It’s a sentiment many artists grapple with, but few express with the profound gratitude of **Ellen Burstyn**. The Oscar-winning legend, now 93, recently marvelled that her continued work in Hollywood feels nothing short of miraculous. Looking back, she confessed that in her younger years, she harbored no illusions about her career extending far into what she considered old age.

"I was sure I’d be finished by 40," Burstyn shared, a stark contrast to her current reality. The fact that she is not only still working but thriving in her 90s is a testament to her resilience and undeniable talent. Her career, which has spanned decades and earned her accolades including an Oscar, Tony, and Emmy, shows no signs of slowing down.

## A Career Defying Expectations

Burstyn's journey is a powerful narrative of artistic endurance. While many actors face a steep decline in opportunities after a certain age, she has consistently found compelling roles. Her recent career highlights include a starring turn in Maggie Gyllenhaal’s short film **'Flesh Impact'**, where she portrayed a 100-year-old Marilyn Monroe. This project premiered alongside her receiving the prestigious Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the 2026 Venice Film Festival. This honor, bestowed upon her on September 7, 2026, celebrated a career that has gifted us iconic performances in films like **'The Exorcist'**, **'Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore'**, and **'Requiem for a Dream'**.

> "I seem to be busier than I’ve ever been in my whole life, and I never at any point earlier would’ve suspected that my busiest time of my life would be in my 90s. My early 40s was the time when my career really blossomed. And I did a lot of films in that period, so I have a lot of identification with that period, but I’m also just very aware that I’m 93 and I’m still working, and here I am." — **Ellen Burstyn**

## A Beacon for Audiences and Artists

For fans who have grown up with **Ellen Burstyn** gracing the screen, her continued presence is a gift. Her ability to deliver nuanced and powerful performances at 93 resonates deeply, proving that age is merely a number when passion and talent are involved. This longevity is particularly inspiring in an industry often perceived as youth-obsessed. Her career serves as a powerful reminder to audiences that compelling storytelling knows no age limit and that seasoned performers can offer unparalleled depth and wisdom. It’s a narrative that not only celebrates Burstyn but also champions the value of experience in the arts.

## What's Next

Looking ahead, **Ellen Burstyn** is slated to appear in the upcoming production of **'Fuddy Meers'**, where she is listed for the role of Gertie. The project is currently in pre-production, signaling that her remarkable journey in film and theatre is far from over.
